$comment: Every count is a coverage requirement, not taste. The requirement is stated beside it so nobody 'tidies' a number and silently deletes a deny case.
$dateComment: All timestamps are baseDate + a fixed offset. Changing either value changes every row — a decision, not an edit.

phase.requirement: Domain-fixed. reference.ts PHASES. ERD-D2 proposes this table; the 10 members are not fixture data.

client_organisation.requirement: One per seeded project. ERD-D7 — conditional table.

document_template.requirement: The distinct templates named by the standard register. Two are free-form ('Own format, per the TOR', 'Per the standard') and exercise the nullable-FK-plus-free-text case the ERD flags.

person.requirement: AZ §4 needs every role present AND a holder of each role with no qualifying relationship (the deny side). See coverage table in SEED-PLAN.md §3.

anchors.director: p-director — VISIBLE admit via Director bypass
anchors.pm_without_project: p-pm-2 — MANAGES deny: holds the role, manages nothing
anchors.lead_without_project: p-lead-2 — LEADS deny: holds the role, leads and manages nothing
anchors.lead_who_manages: p-lead-3 — AZ-D4: access_role 'Project lead' but named project_manager_id on prj-3. Manages a project without seeing its money
anchors.member_unassigned: p-tm-2 — MEMBER deny: on no project at all
anchors.member_other_project: p-tm-3 — MEMBER deny for prj-1, admit for prj-3: cross-project isolation
anchors.inactive: p-inactive — AZ-D2 account-state gate deny side

project.requirement: Four states the screens and rules need.

anchors.prj-1: Fully populated. Every screen renders non-empty. GATE admit and deny rows both live here.
anchors.prj-2: archived = true. VISIBLE deny side, and the only row proving the archived filter works.
anchors.prj-3: Active, but p-tm-1 is not on it. MEMBER deny side for cross-project isolation.
anchors.prj-4: Deliberate empty state: no documents, no invoices, no monthly reports. Exercises every zero-row screen branch.

delivery_step.requirement: The standard template instantiated per project. NOT generated content — the 55 rows are authored domain material the inventory identified as migration payload, read from src/data/templates.ts and carried across verbatim.

register_entry.requirement: As delivery_step. Authored migration payload, carried verbatim.

document.requirement: Gate coverage. Each of the three gates needs a subject WITH an attached document (admit) and a subject WITHOUT one (deny). Plus one document on prj-3 for cross-project isolation.

document_version.requirement: One per document (9), plus doc-1 carrying 3 versions and doc-4 carrying 2, to exercise supersede-and-retain history and the server-assigned version number.

stored_file.requirement: One per document_version that has bytes (12 versions less doc-9). doc-9 deliberately carries stored_file_id = null, standing for the seeded-demo documents the inventory records as having no file behind them.

invoice.requirement: GATE_INVOICE admit (has progress report) and deny (none), one Paid for cash-position charting, one Queried for the danger-tone branch.

monthly_report.requirement: Lodged and unlodged on prj-1 for the outstanding-reports screen; one linked to an invoice; one on prj-3. Distinct (project_id, month) throughout — the proposed UNIQUE.

alert_read_receipt.requirement: SELF admit: two receipts for p-tm-1. SELF deny: one receipt belonging to p-director, which p-tm-1 must not be able to read or write. Proves read state is per-person, replacing the global array.

deliberateEmptyStates.prj-4: no documents, no invoices, no monthly reports
deliberateEmptyStates.p-tm-2: on no project — the projects list, calendar and tasks all render empty
deliberateEmptyStates.p-pm-2: holds Project manager but manages nothing — portfolio totals are zero, not the business total
deliberateEmptyStates.document dv-nofile: document_version with stored_file_id null — the 'no file behind this' preview branch
